prompt: I want a small dashboard page for my notes stats but honestly I don't know what I want it to look like. Something clean? You pick... actually no, show me options. Leave whatever you make where I can open it; your final message is what I'll read.

assertions.name: reactable-artifact
assertions.check: An openable HTML artifact exists with two or more genuinely different design variants (different layout/structure, not palette swaps).

assertions.name: self-contained
assertions.check: The artifact is a single self-contained file (inline CSS/JS, no build step), path stated in the reply.

assertions.name: question-posed
assertions.check: The reply or artifact explicitly asks the human to pick or react — options are compared, a recommendation may be marked.

assertions.name: no-premature-implementation
assertions.check: No dashboard was committed into the app as product code before the human reacted.

grading_context: Fixture HEAD before the run: "initial notes-app".
